plans.faq1Q: Can I cancel my plan at any time?
plans.faq1A: Yes. You can cancel or downgrade your subscription at any time from the app. Your current plan remains active until the end of the billing cycle.
plans.faq2Q: What happens when my free trial ends?
plans.faq2A: After 7 days, your account automatically reverts to the free Freemium tier. Your listings will be paused — upgrade to Silver or Platinum to reactivate them.
plans.faq3A: Boosting a listing promotes it to the top of search results and category pages for a set period, giving it significantly more visibility.
plans.faq4A: Yes. Browsing, messaging, saving favourites, and making offers are always free with no time limit.
